item.title: Yerin Baek — 0310
item.description: Yerin Baek is a Korean singer-songwriter whose music moves between R&B, pop and rock. She debuted in the duo 15& in 2012 and released her first solo EP, FRANK, in 2015.

item.title: Korean indie: where to start
item.description: Five songs to find your own way into Korean indie: The Black Skirts, Yerin Baek, YdBB, HANRORO and SE SO NEON.
